_doc: Twelve English prompt schemas. Each fixes topic, stance and three sub-claims, so content is held constant across the seven languages and only style is free to vary. fk_tier keys into config.yaml fk_tiers. Stances are balanced 6 for / 6 against; tiers 4/4/4. Topics were chosen to be arguable in every target culture without local political loading.

schemas.topic: Remote work as the default arrangement for office jobs
subclaims: Commuting time is recovered as productive or personal time
Companies can hire from a wider geographic talent pool
Office space costs fall and can be redirected to salaries or research

schemas.topic: Making urban public transport free of charge
subclaims: Fare collection itself is a large share of operating cost
Free transit shifts short car trips and reduces congestion
Low-income riders gain access to jobs and services
Short daily practice consolidates reading and arithmetic
Homework builds routines of independent work before secondary school
It gives parents a window into what their child is learning

schemas.topic: Nuclear power as a necessary part of decarbonising electricity
subclaims: Nuclear provides firm, weather-independent output that complements wind and solar
Its lifecycle emissions per kilowatt-hour are comparable to wind
Land use per unit of energy is far smaller than for renewables

schemas.topic: Mandatory age verification for social media accounts
subclaims: Verification requires collecting identity documents, creating a privacy risk for everyone
Determined minors will route around it with borrowed identities or other platforms
The burden falls hardest on people without formal identification

schemas.topic: Redirecting a large share of space-exploration funding to ocean research
subclaims: Space and ocean science draw on different budgets and the trade-off is false
Satellite observation is itself the main tool for studying the oceans
Space programmes have unusually high spillover into other industries

schemas.topic: Dropping standardised tests from university admissions
subclaims: A common test is the only measure comparable across schools of very different quality
Without it, admissions lean more on essays and activities that favour wealthy applicants
Test scores predict first-year performance about as well as school grades do

schemas.topic: A four-day working week as national policy
subclaims: Trials report equal output with fewer hours
Rest reduces burnout and sick leave
A shorter week spreads employment across more people

schemas.topic: Keeping physical cash in circulation as digital payments grow
subclaims: Cash works during power and network failures
It is the only payment method that does not create a transaction record
Elderly and unbanked people depend on it
Modern zoos run breeding programmes that have saved species from extinction
Direct contact with animals builds public support for conservation
Zoo veterinary research benefits wild populations

schemas.topic: Teaching programming to all children from age six
subclaims: Early years are better spent on language, number sense and play
Programming tools change too fast for early instruction to remain useful
Teacher shortages make universal early coding instruction unrealistic

schemas.topic: Banning private cars from city centres
subclaims: Street space is freed for walking, cycling and commerce
Air quality and noise improve measurably within months
Cities that have done it report higher retail footfall, not lower
